base_prompts.v1:
Use case: style-transfer. Production game sprite animation sheet. The reference image is the ART STYLE AUTHORITY: existing Tiny RPG sprites enlarged by nearest-neighbor. Match its EXTREMELY SMALL native pixel scale, chunky 1-pixel near-black outline, broad flat color clusters, large head, tiny short legs, modest 3/4 side view facing RIGHT, and about 20-28 palette colors for the entire character. Draw like a 20-pixel-tall original sprite enlarged exactly 8x, NOT detailed high-resolution pixel art. No subpixel details, texture, antialiasing, gradients, realism, rimlight, glow, painterly shading, or extra accessories. Color contrast and one-pixel shapes must have the same tiny-game readability as the reference. Keep character identity and scale consistent across every frame.
OUTPUT: one transparent PNG sprite sheet, precisely SIX equally spaced columns by FIVE equally spaced rows (30 poses). No text, labels, grid, borders, checkerboard, shadows, floor, scenery, or reference characters in the output. Every equal square cell contains ONE complete character, centered horizontally in neutral frames, same foot baseline, plenty of transparent space, never crosses cell boundaries. Show deliberate articulated poses, no scaling or whole-body sliding disguised as animation.
ROWS top to bottom:
1 IDLE: six very subtle breathing frames, feet planted, tiny torso motion, seamless cycle.
2 BASIC ATTACK: ready, anticipation, fast strike toward RIGHT, maximum extension/compact white impact crescent, recoil, ready. Peak strike at column 3 to match damage timing.
3 SKILL: ready, anticipation, signature skill peak, clear follow-through, settle, ready; visually distinct from basic attack.
4 HURT: ready, initial backward flinch, deepest recoil, recovery, settle, ready.
5 DEATH: ready, stagger, kneel/fall, collapse, motion settling, fully collapsed final pose without recovery.
Preserve exact limited pixel-art rendering in the falling poses and effects too. The neutral poses throughout should be identical. Genuine alpha background.
